name: OryCon
blurb: Portland's long-running general science-fiction convention; its organizer OSFCI ended the event after OryCon 45 in October 2025.
notes: orycon.org is unreachable (net::ERR_CONNECTION_TIMED_OUT via Chromium, ECONNREFUSED via WebFetch), retried once with --channel msedge with the same result, so no homepage/JSON-LD could be rendered. A web search and the OryCon Wikipedia page confirm why: organizer Oregon Science Fiction Conventions, Inc. (OSFCI) voted to end its support of the convention, with OryCon 45 (Oct 17-19, 2025, DoubleTree by Hilton Portland - Lloyd Center) as the final OSFCI-run edition; the con had already gone on pandemic hiatus in 2020-2022 (a free virtual 'Or-E-Con 2' substituted in 2022). No OryCon 46 or any 2026/2027 edition has been announced, so status is inactive with editions left empty rather than guessed.
